# xBRZ 1.9

Author Zenju. The source and license files in this directory are unchanged from the official xBRZ 1.9 archive.

- Upstream archive [xBRZ 1.9](https://sourceforge.net/projects/xbrz/files/xBRZ/xBRZ_1.9.zip/download)
- Archive SHA-256 `b2dff73b3abd24a18a7cde78d5ff5ed8f0922296dce6ed734dce2264cd0a0fc9`
- License GPLv3, with the additional exceptions stated in each upstream source header. The complete upstream license is included in `License.txt`.

The DFLegacy release includes corresponding source and build instructions for the client components that integrate this library. The original game executable and game resources are external runtime inputs.
